hypothesis: The error left after attempt 1 is a curve-shape problem (half-shell break, heavy-end flattening) and a mis-set shrinkage: a hierarchical model of the whole log D curve -- shape coefficients with a full prior covariance, a Z-correlated smooth residual and per-metal reading noise, all estimated by maximum likelihood on the training curves -- predicts the observable adjacent log SF better than RIDGE2+OBS@RESEL at the same supports.
contract: k-shot metal model, k+1 metals read by gen20's DOPT_Q (label-free); the method uses only the support differences to the first read metal. Its parameters (m, S_theta, tau2, rho, sig2) are fitted by chemotype-balanced weighted maximum likelihood on the within-cell contrasts of the OUTER TRAINING cells' observed log D curves; nothing is tuned on held-out cells. k = 0 = the training mean shape (zero-shot, no chemistry). @LATENT = the same model predicting the latent curve (control).
